output.summary: Turnover rise is real (payroll-reconciled, same definitions), so the HRIS artifact claim fails. Cedar Hollow rose 19 points versus about 5 for in-state peers, so regional labor conditions alone do not explain it. Voluntary separations stepped up in March 2026, when the two-Saturday policy took effect at all branches, before ShiftWise go-live in April. Pay was cited at similar rates in both years, and no current market pay data exists. Overtime follows open requisitions, which is a causal link. Branch-level, ShiftWise and manager comparisons are missing, and the manager-of-record field is stale. A pay raise or manager penalties are not justified. Collect branch-level data and market pay first.
